description: Source file implementing ECU Abstraction layer for GPT timers, including initialization, start/stop, callback registration, and notification handling.

methods.name: map_of
methods.description: Finds the channel map entry for a given logic channel.

methods.name: EcuAb_Gpt_Init
methods.description: Initializes GPT channels and enables notifications.

methods.name: EcuAb_Gpt_DeInit
methods.description: De-initializes GPT channels and disables notifications.

methods.name: EcuAb_Gpt_StartTicks
methods.description: Starts a timer on a specified channel with given ticks.

methods.name: EcuAb_Gpt_Stop
methods.description: Stops the timer on a specified channel.

methods.name: EcuAb_Gpt_GetElapsed
methods.description: Returns elapsed time for a channel.

methods.name: EcuAb_Gpt_GetRemaining
methods.description: Returns remaining time for a channel.

methods.name: EcuAb_Gpt_RegisterCallback
methods.description: Registers a callback for a channel.

methods.name: EcuAb_Gpt_OnMcalCb
methods.description: Internal callback invoked by MCAL GPT notification, calls registered app callback.
